forum.title: Temperature compensation of ADXL203
forum.best_answer_content:
The ADXL203 is not an ST Product - it’s from **Analog Devices**:

<https://www.analog.com/en/products/adxl203.html>

You need to go to **Analog Devices** for documentation & support with *their* products!

<https://www.analog.com/en/support.html>

<https://ez.analog.com/>
forum.content_text:
I am using ADXL203  analog inclinometer. I would to compensate the offset variation with temperature.

As the ADXL203 itself does not have an internal temperature sensor, could you give me any advice on how to measure the temperature?

Thank anybody for the attention.

GF
